title: The influence of preoperative planning on the accuracy of dynamic navigation-assisted zygomatic implant placement: a retrospective study
html: This study was designed to investigate the correlation between preoperative planning-related factors and the accuracy of dynamic navigation-assisted zygomatic implant placement. Data were collected from patients who underwent dynamic navigation-assisted zygomatic implant placement between 2019 and 2024. Preoperative planning-related factors, including the density and engagement of the alveolar and zygomatic bone, type of zygomatic anatomy-guided approach, implant strategy, and implant site, were recorded, and the deviations of entry, exit, and angle were measured.
